title: Molen default structure collection
description: Original parametric interpretations of real-world building types. Canonical dimensions are model-sheet examples in meters; runtime requests control their footprint, height, levels and seed. Detail is simplified and does not reproduce site-specific ornament.

entries.title: Contemporary suburban house
entries.description: Worldwide fallback for small residential footprints: hip or gable roofs, neutral render and brick tones, modest eaves. Residential footprints retain this style regardless of area; known heights take precedence, and four or more resolved floors use flat roofs.
